Channels.title: Channels
Channels.testOk: OK — connected as {account}, can post to {target}
Channels.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
Channels.listError: This brand's channels could not be loaded, so this list is not the answer.
Channels.removeBody: Pubrick deletes the stored credentials for {channel} and cannot show them again — you would need new ones from the platform. Anything scheduled for it is cancelled and nothing is published to it afterwards, though posts it already published stay on the record. To replace a revoked token, use Edit instead.
Channels.editCredsHint: Leave these empty to keep the credentials already stored — Pubrick cannot show them again. Fill them in to replace them, which is how you install a new token after the platform revokes one. Scheduled posts stay scheduled and go out with the new credentials.
Channels.editCredsPartial: Fill in every credential field, or leave them all empty. New credentials replace the stored ones as a set, so a half-filled form would leave this channel unable to post.

SettingsPage.aiCostUnknown: cost not reported ({count, plural, one {# call} other {# calls}})

Runs.title: Generation
Runs.claimsEmpty: No factual claims were listed for this draft.

failure.cancelled: The model call was cancelled before it finished.
failure.every_channel_deleted: Every channel this run was started for has since been deleted. Add a channel and try again.
failure.internal: Something went wrong on our side. Try again.
failure.invalid_key: The provider rejected the API key. Check it in Settings.
failure.model_not_found: The provider does not recognise the model id set in Settings.
failure.no_api_key: No AI provider key is configured. Add one in Settings, then try again.
failure.no_structured_output: The model could not return the structured output Pubrick needs. Try another model.
failure.provider_refused: The provider refused the request. Check the key and the model id in Settings.
failure.rate_limited: The provider is rate-limiting or temporarily unavailable. This run will be retried.
failure.retries_exhausted: This run was retried until its attempts ran out. Try again.
failure.timed_out: The model call ran out of time before the provider answered. This run will be retried.
failure.too_long_for_channel: The model could not fit one of the channels' length limits. Try a shorter brief.
failure.unreadable_key: The stored API key could not be read. Save it again in Settings.

Runs.draftDeleted: This run's draft has been deleted.
Runs.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.

Errors.content_not_found: This post no longer exists — it may have been deleted.
Errors.adaptation_not_found: This channel's own text no longer exists — the channel may have been deleted.
Errors.content_pinned_approved: An approved post cannot be edited. Reject it first.
Errors.content_pinned_published: This post has already been published and can no longer be edited.
Errors.adaptation_pinned_scheduled: A scheduled post cannot be edited. Reject the post first.
Errors.adaptation_pinned_queued: This post is already queued for publishing and cannot be edited. Reject it first.
Errors.adaptation_pinned_publishing: This post is being published right now and cannot be edited. Reject it first.
Errors.adaptation_pinned_published: This channel's post has already been published and can no longer be edited.
Errors.content_already_published: This post has already been published; it can no longer be approved or rejected.
Errors.content_no_channels_left: This post has no channels left to publish to — every channel it was written for has been deleted.
Errors.unread_ai_draft: No one has read this AI-written draft yet. Open it, or edit it, before approving.
Errors.unread_ai_draft_open_only: No one has read the AI-written text in this post yet. Open it before approving — editing the text cannot clear this, because no complete AI version of it was ever recorded.
Errors.schedule_in_past: Pick a time in the future to schedule this post.
Errors.channels_not_in_brand: One or more of the chosen channels do not belong to this brand. Reload the page and pick them again.
Errors.brand_not_found: This brand no longer exists — it may have been deleted.
Errors.brand_has_no_channels: This brand has no channels yet. Add one before generating.
Errors.run_limit_reached: You already have {limit} generations queued or running. Wait for one to finish, or cancel it.
Errors.run_not_cancellable_succeeded: This generation has already finished; its draft is ready.
Errors.run_not_cancellable_failed: This generation has already failed; there is nothing left to cancel.
Errors.run_not_cancellable_cancelled: This generation has already been cancelled.
Errors.run_not_dismissable_queued: A queued generation cannot be dismissed. Cancel it first.
Errors.run_not_dismissable_running: A running generation cannot be dismissed. Cancel it first.
Errors.ai_credential_not_found: No API key is stored for this provider. Save one first.
Errors.invalid_request: Some of what you entered is not valid. Check the form and try again.
Errors.signed_out: You're signed out. Log in again to continue.
Errors.no_active_organization: No active organization — create or select one first.
Errors.forbidden: You don't have access to this.
